name: learned GOOSE anomaly detector, version 2: stream history and incident grouping, PowerDuck substation captures
registered: 2026-11-24, before version 2 code read any PowerDuck record
relation_to_version_1: Version 1 (experiment-b/powerduck) was tested once on these 16 attack captures: all 16 flagged, 14 at their first message, but 3.0% of non-malicious messages alerted against a 1% ceiling, and only 15.1% of malicious messages outside the floods were detected. Those results and the per-scenario figures have been seen. This is a second measurement on the same captures, made after the changes its evidence named; it is not an unseen test.

changes_from_version_1.history: Each message is also compared with its stream's last 20 messages (history_features.py): robust distance of timing, values, length and rate from their recent median, and counts of recent state-number jumps and sequence-number breaks.
changes_from_version_1.threshold: The alert threshold is set at 0.5% of held-out normal messages (version 1 used 1%, and its held-out normal captures alerted at 1.1% to 1.8%).
changes_from_version_1.incidents: Alerts no more than 2 s apart are grouped into one incident; incidents with no malicious message are false incidents, reported per hour of capture.

source.dataset: PowerDuck: GOOSE data set of cyberattacks in substations (Zemanek, Hacker, Wolsing, Kaufmann, Klapperich, Henze, 2022), Zenodo record 6724225

labels: A message is malicious when its IPAL 'malicious' field is truthy. Labels are read only in the test stage.
model: sklearn IsolationForest(n_estimators=300, max_samples=2048, random_state=20261124) fitted on normal messages only, on version 1 features plus the history features and the stream one-hot.
fit_and_threshold: Each normal capture split in time: first 70% fits, last 30% sets the threshold at 0.5% of those messages. No hyperparameter is chosen.
development_reporting: Leave one normal capture out: message alert rate and incidents per hour on the held-out capture. Reported, not used to change anything.
freeze: SHA-256 of the model bundle, of history_features.py, detector_v2.py, this file and version 1's goose_features.py, and the archive pin.
pass_condition: Same as version 1: non-malicious message alert rate at most 1% pooled over the 16 attack captures AND at least 12 of 16 scenarios with a malicious message alerted. False incidents per hour and per-scenario detection are reported alongside.
not_claimed: An unseen test (the captures were seen in version 1); behaviour in other substations.
